name: Inverse Reconstruction with a Learned Generative Prior
name_zh: 基于学习型生成先验的反演
summary: Constrain inverse reconstructions to the range or plausible manifold of a pretrained generator.
summary_zh: 利用预训练生成模型的输出空间约束欠定逆问题的候选解。
core_idea: Optimize latent inputs of a learned generator instead of an unconstrained high-dimensional physical variable.
innovation: Provides a nontraditional structural prior for inverse reconstruction when true solutions lie near training distribution.
limitations: The generator may exclude physically valid solutions outside its training support.
Latent inversion can be nonconvex and the induced prior may be hard to characterize.

start_here.why: Landmark theoretical result for generative-range compressed sensing.
start_here.focus: Measurement model, generator range assumption and recovery guarantee.

curation_note: Bibliographic identity verified against authoritative proceedings; downstream physical inverse validity must be separately evaluated.
